name: UOM Fibers Are Proper Conditionings of Minimal-Non-Ample Parents
statement: UOMFib consists exactly of the finite cubes and, after fixed coordinates are suppressed, the nonempty classes obtained by fixing at least one coordinate of a conditioning-minimal non-ample parent. Apart from the parallel rank-one case, those parents are precisely the connected conditioning-minimal non-ample classes, equivalently the full tope sets of non-free simple uniform oriented matroids.
proof: The minimal-non-ample classification identifies every nontrivial simple parent with a non-free uniform-oriented-matroid tope set, and its proper conditionings are exactly its nonempty topal fibers. Conversely, a noncube UOM fiber comes from a non-free uniform oriented matroid of rank at least two, whose full tope set is such a parent. Rank-one fibers are singletons and the definition includes all cubes separately.
comments: This is a parent-to-fiber construction, not a class inclusion: the full connected parents are non-ample, whereas every UOMFib member is ample.
